name: SOC335 - CVE-2024-49138 Privilege Escalation
description: Technique mapping for LetsDefend alert SOC335 (CVE-2024-49138 Exploitation Detected, host Victor). See technique-breakdown.md in zaimmzulhazziq/mitre-attack-mapping for the full evidence trail behind each mapping.

techniques.comment: 14x failed RDP logons (EventID 4625) against admin/guest from 185.107.56.141. Log Management, Authentication logs.
Successful RDP logon as Victor (EventID 4624, Logon Type 10) immediately after the brute-force burst. Judgment call vs T1078 Valid Accounts - see technique-breakdown.md.
whoami / whoami /priv run to enumerate current user and token privileges. Terminal History.
PowerShell used to run Invoke-WebRequest downloading the payload archive. Terminal History.
Payload archive pulled from an external S3 staging URL. Only visible in Terminal History - absent from Network Action / outbound-IP logs.
Archive extracted with a hardcoded 7-Zip password to prevent content scanning. Terminal History.
Payload named svohost.exe to mimic svchost.exe. Ran from C:\temp\, not the legitimate System32 path.
svohost.exe exploited CVE-2024-49138. Device Action: Allowed - endpoint agent did not block a file already flagged malicious by 50/71 VirusTotal vendors.
